title: Add Environment
description: Add a named environment to some or all apps, copied from an existing one: env file (secret values become ${APP_ENV_KEY} placeholders), Angular build/serve configurations, release configuration (hardening, base href), Flutter env json and build configurations, npm scripts.

name.description: Environment name (lowercase kebab-case, e.g. qa, sit, staging). dev, uat, prod and production are reserved.

projects.description: Apps to add the environment to. Either this or all.

all.description: Add the environment to every app with environments.

from.description: Existing environment the new one is copied from (default: uat, else prod for apps without uat).

apiUrl.description: API base URL for the new environment (fields whose key mentions api).

production.description: Set production: true|false in the new Angular env file (default: as in --from).

baseHref.description: Base href of the new release / Flutter build-web configuration (default: as in --from).

domains.description: Hosts the new aes-gcm release configuration may run on (default: none).
